summary: Task specs require one-step tier escalation from start_tier; hosts get pure next_run_state and optional spend metadata.tier_step.
migration_impact: Task YAML with multi-step or mismatched escalation.from must be corrected before validate passes. Hosts may call next_run_state and persist run state before each model invocation.
agent_notes: Validate .agentic/tasks with gh plate tasks validate; escalation.to must be exactly one tier above start_tier. Use next_run_state human_escalation_approved for the T3 gate; terminal states are idempotent. Record tier_step start|escalated on spend intervals when piloting crews.
